sequence_points.name: Landscape with Mountains and Trees
sequence_points.description: A horizontal ink wash painting depicting a misty mountain landscape with sparse trees and layered rock formations, rendered in monochromatic tones of black, gray, and brown. The artwork is mounted on a wall, appearing aged with visible texture and subtle discoloration.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Composition with Rust-like Streaks
sequence_points.description: A large abstract painting featuring horizontal bands of muted blue-gray tones with irregular, rust-colored streaks across the upper portion. The artwork is mounted on a wall and appears to have a textured surface.
